note: GymOps has no compiled component library (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, no runtime deps), so the design-sync converter path does not apply. This project is a hand-authored CARD CATALOGUE: preview HTML with @dsCard markers, plus a verbatim mirror of css/style.css. There is deliberately no _ds_bundle.js, no .d.ts and no .jsx — a design agent can read the conventions and styles here but cannot compose GymOps components, because none exist. Do not generate React wrappers to fill the gap: that would be a reimplementation and a second source of truth that drifts from css/style.css.
syncAnchor: none — _ds_sync.json is deliberately omitted; its hash recipe needs build facts this shape has no equivalent of, so every re-sync re-verifies from scratch
